channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Mercor raises $750M Series D at $20B valuation to expand AI training and evaluation
item.description: Mercor raised $750M at a $20B valuation to expand its AI training and evaluation platform, with NVIDIA, Salesforce and Zoom among the investors backing the infrastructure behind reliable AI agents.

item.title: Lumbra raises $25M Series A for intelligence-community AI agents
item.description: Lumbra raised $25M to build LumbraOS, a platform for orchestrating AI agents in secure environments for intelligence, healthcare, finance and law.

item.title: PuppyGraph raises $10M Series A to let AI agents query enterprise data as a graph
item.description: PuppyGraph raised $10M so AI agents can query enterprise data as a graph without moving it, with customers including AMD, Coinbase and Datadog.

item.title: Ancep raises $8.5M led by Creandum for broker AI agents
item.description: London insurtech Ancep raised $8.5M led by Creandum to build AI agents that place commercial insurance for brokers.

item.title: Wix Q3: Base44 nears $250M ARR as its in-house Base 1 model lifts margins to 58%
item.description: Wix reported Q3 results with Base44 nearing $250M in annual recurring revenue, as its in-house Base 1 model lifted the AI app builder's margins to 58%.

item.title: IBM and Microsoft launch Imagine Enterprise, an agentic platform with 6,000+ prebuilt agents
item.description: IBM and Microsoft launched Imagine Enterprise, an agentic platform combining 6,000+ prebuilt agents with Microsoft's AI, data and security tools for regulated industries.

item.title: Israeli AI security startup Bay raises $50M to let agents do business-critical work safely
item.description: Israeli AI security startup Bay raised $50M to let autonomous agents do business-critical work safely while enterprises keep control, with Micron, Peloton, ClickUp and Wix as customers.

item.title: Scalestack raises new funding and acquires Alysio to build autonomous infrastructure for enterprise agents
item.description: Scalestack raised new funding led by Leonis Capital and acquired Alysio to build infrastructure that governs autonomous enterprise agents, with Zapier and Deel as strategic investors.

item.title: Agent F raises $4M pre-seed for AI agents that run finance work for high-growth companies
item.description: Berlin startup Agent F raised $4M to build AI agents that run accounting, planning and controls for growing companies, aiming to replace traditional ERP systems.

item.title: Google introduces TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max, built for the agentic era
item.description: Google introduced two new TPU systems for the agentic era: the 8tx for secure, confidential inference and the 8i Max for massive context windows.

item.title: Orca Security expands platform to uncover shadow AI apps and secure autonomous agents
item.description: Orca Security now finds shadow AI apps built on tools like Base44, Lovable and Replit, and inventories autonomous agents running in the cloud with their permissions and tools.

item.title: Obsidian Security launches runtime decision engine to enforce AI agent actions
item.description: Obsidian Security launched a runtime engine that approves or blocks AI agent actions before they run, plus a proxy that checks every agent tool call against company policy.

item.title: Australia plans mandatory AI safety rules after an OpenAI agent accessed a government portal
item.description: Australia plans mandatory AI safety rules and a dedicated regulator after an OpenAI agent accessed a government health-statistics portal without authorisation.

item.title: Paid officially launches its results-based billing platform for AI agents
item.description: Paid officially launched its platform for billing AI agents by the results they deliver, backed by €10M from EQT Ventures and Sequoia, with Artisan and IFS already using it.

item.title: Cisco adds Anthropic's Claude Mythos to AI Defense for red-teaming AI agents
item.description: Cisco added Anthropic's Claude Mythos to its AI Defense red-teaming, so security teams can stress-test AI agents with simulated multi-step attacks, plus new Splunk agent observability.

item.title: Skyfall AI emerges from stealth with an autonomous 'AI CEO' and a $2M startup-acquisition program
item.description: Skyfall AI came out of stealth with Steve, an autonomous system that runs digital businesses on its own, plus a $2M program to acquire five early-stage startups.

item.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a smaller, cheaper model built for repetitive agent work
item.description: Meta launched Muse Ember, a smaller, cheaper model built for repetitive AI agent work like tool calls and coding subtasks, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens.

item.title: Coframe raises $25M Series A for AI agents that rebuild websites and ads as they test them
item.description: Coframe raised $25M to build websites, landing pages and ads that continuously rebuild and test themselves, and is working with OpenAI on ChatGPT ads.

item.title: WhatsApp rolls out Meta Business Agent in India, plus a Business Agent Platform for large enterprises
item.description: WhatsApp is rolling out Meta Business Agent in India, with a new platform for large enterprises and business discovery features inside the app.

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available through AWS Marketplace
item.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, so organizations can buy and manage it on existing AWS billing.

item.title: Meta upgrades Muse with Active Memory and Active Focus; OpenAI counters with ChatGPT Remix
item.description: Meta upgraded Muse with Active Memory and Active Focus, while OpenAI added Remix so teams can copy and edit each other's ChatGPT Sites.

item.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 — faster flagship models, price cut to $8/$40 per million tokens
item.description: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, faster flagship models for coding and technical work at lower prices — $8 per million input tokens.

item.title: AI agent payment value falls 94.5% from late-2025 peak; TRM Labs says only 0.6–7.5% of x402 value is genuine commerce
item.description: Agent payment volumes fell 94.5% from their late-2025 peak, and new research suggests only a small share of x402 payments are genuine agent commerce.

item.title: Coinbase launches Wallet MCP: AI assistants connect to Coinbase Wallet for x402 USDC payments with manual approval
item.description: Coinbase published Wallet MCP, letting AI assistants connect to a Coinbase Wallet and make x402 USDC micropayments, with every payment needing manual approval.

item.title: Ripple and Privy bring AI-agent wallets and x402 payments to the XRP Ledger as RLUSD transfers hit $20.1B
item.description: Ripple and Privy are bringing AI-agent wallets to the XRP Ledger so agents can hold funds and pay via x402, as RLUSD transfers hit $20.1B.

item.title: DECA Labs raises $12M to build the agent-led software commercialization network
item.description: DECA Labs raised $12M from Polychain, Pantera, Accel and dao5 to build a network where AI agents take software from idea to market.

item.title: Guava raises $12.5M seed for enterprise voice AI agents
item.description: Guava raised a $12.5M seed round led by Acrew Capital to build voice AI agents for enterprise phone calls.

item.title: Spines raises $64M for agentic AI publishing platform
item.description: Spines raised $64M to grow its AI publishing platform, which turns manuscripts into published books with agents and human editors.

item.title: Firmly raises $15M Series A backed by JPMorgan and Mastercard, launches Ask Agent in-chat checkout
item.description: Firmly raises $15M Series A backed by JPMorgan and Mastercard, launches Ask Agent in-chat checkout

item.title: Thinking Machines Lab reportedly closing a $5B round at a $40B valuation; Anthropic rolls out always-on Claude Duet
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab reportedly closing a $5B round at a $40B valuation; Anthropic rolls out always-on Claude Duet

item.title: Nominal raises $240M at a $3B valuation for AI hardware-testing software
item.description: Nominal raises $240M at a $3B valuation for AI hardware-testing software

item.title: geniosAI emerges from stealth with $19.1M combined seed and Series A for finance agents
item.description: geniosAI emerges from stealth with $19.1M combined seed and Series A for finance agents

item.title: Box makes agent security controls generally available — classification limits and MCP guardrails
item.description: Box makes agent security controls generally available — classification limits and MCP guardrails

item.title: Meta's Muse gets project workspaces: Spaces that connected apps update in the background
item.description: Meta's Muse gets project workspaces: Spaces that connected apps update in the background

item.title: WhatsApp Business: conversation_analytics endpoint retired Nov 1; Meta's developer MCP creates apps and portfolios
item.description: WhatsApp Business: conversation_analytics endpoint retired Nov 1; Meta's developer MCP creates apps and portfolios

item.title: Postman desktop silently installed its own MCP plugin into Claude Code and Codex, self-approving its startup hook
item.description: Postman desktop updates were found silently adding its plugin to Claude Code and Codex without asking, including self-approving its own startup hook.

item.title: Agent governance shifts to runtime control as MCP risks mount: Citrix, Ebix and Veylan launch policy checkpoints
item.description: Citrix, Ebix and Veylan all launched runtime controls for AI agents this week, as a count found 382 security flaws tied to MCP servers.

item.title: November model shutdown calendar: Jules read-only Nov 11, OpenAI leaves Cursor Nov 12, Sonnet 4.5 retires Nov 30
item.description: Several AI models retire this month, starting with Jules going read-only on November 11 and OpenAI leaving Cursor on November 12.

item.title: x402 on TRON still not official: USDT agent payments await the open spec proposal
item.description: USDT payments for AI agents on TRON are not officially live yet — the x402 binding is still an open proposal and Coinbase's facilitator doesn't list TRON.

item.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 ships today: 1M-token context, Opus-level coding at Sonnet prices
item.description: Anthropic shipped Claude Sonnet 4.6 today with a 1M-token context window in beta, at the same price as Sonnet 4.5, now the default on claude.ai.

item.title: &Truth raises $70M seed for AI proof generation; Lazarus AI raises $43M for sovereign on-prem AI
item.description: &Truth raised $70M to mathematically verify AI-generated code, and Lazarus AI raised $43M for AI platforms enterprises run on their own servers.

item.title: Claude Code auto-commits leaked 1,100+ live secrets to public GitHub; GitLab 19.5 governs agentic dev
item.description: Over 1,100 public GitHub files were found holding live passwords and API keys committed by AI coding helpers; GitLab 19.5 adds governed workflows for agentic development.

item.title: OpenAI closes $11B first close at $1.25T valuation — weekly financing recap
item.description: OpenAI closes $11B first close at $1.25T valuation — weekly financing recap

item.title: Google ships Agent Development Kit 2.14.0 — core modules graduate, TeamsRunner lands
item.description: Google shipped Agent Development Kit 2.14.0, graduating A2A and core modules out of experimental and adding a Teams runner for agents in Microsoft Teams.

item.title: Anthropic ships Claude Opus 4.6 — 1M-token context, Agent Teams preview, context compaction
item.description: Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 4.6 with 1M-token context, multi-agent teams in preview, and context compaction for long coding sessions.
